limits.scope: Per page observer and per reader kind, not total browser buffering or pending native requests.

validation.deadlineQualification: Registered callbacks invoked deterministically; no measured thirty-second wall-clock expiry.
validation.wireQualification: Actual UMP request/identity parser with owned bounded wire fixtures. Real XHR uses routed CORS responses; other stream cases use owned native Web Streams.
limitations: Both bundles run in Edge engine; native worker ordering/restart/clock tests use simulated API/storage harnesses, not a real browser worker restart.
Mixed JSON/request/response reader pressure and pending byte snapshots retained before response headers need separate qualification.
Native Blob body reads have no abortable reader handle; the response inspector can retire without awaiting them.
Fresh-clone stale page metadata and legitimate in-place mutation source authority remain open.
Activated Chrome/Firefox, live public video/pre-roll, end-to-end desktop/file verification, installed acceptance, full suite and paired IDM comparison remain outstanding.
